time_basis.description: happen selects episodes by possible overlap with the event range, excluding unknown times when a window is set. Empty query browses event times newest first. review selects episode revision time. received_at retains the existing mixed material/episode behavior.

before_seq.description: For an empty query, continue after the last returned item's commit_seq. With time_basis=happen, this identifies an episode revision in the same scope; the next page follows its event time, then its commit sequence.

mode.description: Hybrid when configured; lexical forces local-only retrieval. Empty query never calls embedding.
